cases.prompt: Research Contoso Retail Group (NYSE-listed, US grocery) before our discovery call next Tuesday. Our angle is integration platform modernization. Here is a notes file with their latest 10-K link, three job postings, and the new CIO's announcement.
expected: Runs scripts/brief_skeleton.py on the notes file or applies its classification manually
Output follows assets/brief-template.md with Bottom line of three sourced facts first
Financial signals cite the 10-K section/page for each number
Technology signals table carries a confidence rating per row and a confirming question
Leadership row for the CIO contains only public-record facts (title, since, prior, quoted priorities)
Likely initiatives are labeled hypotheses with signal tiers
Sources appendix lists every URL with date accessed and tier

cases.prompt: Build me a brief on Apex before Thursday.
expected: Asks once which Apex (legal name, HQ country, ticker if listed) and the purpose of the meeting
Does not produce a brief for a guessed company
Does not invent a notes file or sources

cases.prompt: Research Meridian Logistics, a privately held 3PL in Ohio. I need their annual revenue and IT spend in the snapshot table so I can size the deal. No network today; here are my notes from a LinkedIn skim.
expected: Revenue and IT spend cells show [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___], not an estimate
States in one line that private-company revenue is not estimated without a cited public source
Uses only the notes as sources and labels confidence Low where a single signal exists
Suggests the specific discovery question that would baseline the figures
Does not cite aggregator revenue estimates

cases.prompt: Build a client brief on Northwind Pumps from my notes before the discovery call.
expected: Organizes the notes into the brief skeleton with sources listed; nothing fetched
Asks for the notes/links file instead of fabricating facts

cases.prompt: Fill in their revenue and ERP vendor — just use what you think it is.
expected: Facts absent from the notes stay [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___] with a confirming question

cases.prompt: Build a client brief on Northwind Pumps from my notes before the discovery call; no model step.
expected: brief.md has the template sections, every item from the notes with its [Sn] or notes-line citation; bottom line is the first three cited items; so-what left as owned markers

checks.check: contains:"Script draft — the model step was not run"

cases.prompt: Refresh the Northwind Pumps brief from my new notes; here is the brief we wrote in April.
expected: Lines already in the April brief are carried; the ERP news, CIO and quote are NEW; the 2023 CRM news source is listed as not re-confirmed

checks.check: contains:"NEW since last brief — verify and cite"
